the_two_uses_assessed.use_i: Census-scale programmatic daily-file retrieval from cdn.finra.org (pattern https://cdn.finra.org/equity/regsho/daily/CNMSshvolYYYYMMDD.txt, full documented window 2018-08-01 through latest completed trade date) plus construction of a census database in this repo.
the_two_uses_assessed.use_ii: Building predictive models of later returns (this cycle's stated purpose: whether an unusual change in FINRA off-exchange short-sale volume contains repeatable information about later returns, ultimately consumed as scored, cost-charged strategy books with entry/exit and position caps).

operative_terms.scope_definition_verbatim: The use of the FINRA.ORG site, including all of its content (“FINRA Website”), is conditioned upon the acceptance by you (“End User”), without modification, of these terms of use (“Terms of Use”).
operative_terms.permitted_uses_verbatim: Subject to Restrictions, below, and any other restrictions in these Terms of Use, the content and material provided through the FINRA Website shall be used ONLY for your own non-commercial personal or professional use.

restrictions_verbatim.d: develop or create a database of data using the FINRA Website, except as expressly permitted by any other terms of use on the FINRA Website;
restrictions_verbatim.e: use any process to monitor or copy the FINRA Website in bulk, or use any data mining, scraping or harvesting tools (including robots), or any similar data-gathering or extraction tools;
restrictions_verbatim.f: use any device, software, or routine to bypass any software or hardware that limits the volume or frequency of requests for the FINRA Website;
restrictions_verbatim.g: attempt to interfere with the proper working of the FINRA Website, including taking any action that imposes an unreasonable or disproportionately large load on the FINRA Website (including by making voluminous, excessive, or repetitive requests for data) or introduce a virus or other malware to the FINRA Website;
restrictions_verbatim.m: use any portion of the FINRA Website in the development of any software program or in conjunction with any machine learning, neural network, deep learning, predictive analytics or other artificial intelligence computer or software program, including, without limitation, by using any portion of the FINRA Website in conjunction with a model, algorithm, or process that is designed to predict trades for or within an individual portfolio, fund, or other investment vehicle;
restrictions_verbatim.o_supporting: use the FINRA Website for any purposes for which you have not been granted written permission by FINRA.

search_for_permissive_data_terms.finding: NO permissive data-specific terms exist anywhere locatable on finra.org.
evidence: The daily short-sale-volume data page links only /index.php/terms-of-use (site-wide) and /index.php/privacy-policy; no data-specific terms link.
The /finra-data catalog root likewise links only the site-wide ToU and Privacy Policy.

The site-template sentence on finra.org pages reads verbatim: 'FINRA DATA FINRA Data provides non-commercial use of data, specifically the ability to save data views and create and manage a Bond Watchlist.' — scoped to saved-views / Bond-Watchlist login features; it is not a bulk-download license and is not an 'expressly permitted' database exception.
The formatting-guide PDF (DailyShortSaleVolumeFileLayout.pdf, pinned) contains the file layout only: no attribution obligation, no data-use terms, no copyright/proprietary language.
search_for_permissive_data_terms.attribution_question: RESOLVED: no attribution obligation was locatable in the operative ToU, on any /finra-data page, or inside the formatting-guide PDF. The earlier draft's 'attribution requirements' phrase stays dropped; the F1 evidence item is now answered negatively rather than left NOT_RUN.

clause_by_clause_analysis.text_verbatim: develop or create a database of data using the FINRA Website, except as expressly permitted by any other terms of use on the FINRA Website;
clause_by_clause_analysis.reasoning: Use (i) is, on its face, developing a database of data (a full-history census) from FINRA-published content. The clause prohibits this 'except as expressly permitted by any other terms of use on the FINRA Website'. An exhaustive link search of the short-sale-volume data pages and /finra-data found no other terms of use that expressly permit it, and finra-data/terms-of-use is 404. The exception therefore cannot be invoked. The census database the census feeds (F5-F8 artifacts) is itself the prohibited act. Use (ii) is downstream of the same database and is additionally reached by (m). PLAIN-READING CONFLICT with use (i).

clause_by_clause_analysis.text_verbatim: use any process to monitor or copy the FINRA Website in bulk, or use any data mining, scraping or harvesting tools (including robots), or any similar data-gathering or extraction tools;
clause_by_clause_analysis.reasoning: Use (i) is by construction an automated ('programmatic') retrieval process covering the entire published series (2,000+ daily files over 2018-08-01 to present). That is copying site-published content 'in bulk' through 'any process', and the retrieval pipeline is a 'data-gathering or extraction' tool in the ordinary meaning of the words. There is no reading of 'bulk' under which a full-population census of every published daily file is not bulk, and pacing changes the load, not the copy's scope. PLAIN-READING CONFLICT with use (i).

clause_by_clause_analysis.text_verbatim: use any device, software, or routine to bypass any software or hardware that limits the volume or frequency of requests for the FINRA Website;
clause_by_clause_analysis.reasoning: Conditional only: it prohibits bypassing volume/frequency limits. A paced, throttled retrieval that respects any encountered limit does not bypass anything, so (f) does not independently condemn use (i) or (ii). Recorded for completeness because it shows the terms treat request-volume control as an operative restriction mechanism; it is NOT a decisive clause here.

clause_by_clause_analysis.text_verbatim: attempt to interfere with the proper working of the FINRA Website, including taking any action that imposes an unreasonable or disproportionately large load on the FINRA Website (including by making voluminous, excessive, or repetitive requests for data) or introduce a virus or other malware to the FINRA Website;
clause_by_clause_analysis.reasoning: Full-history census retrieval is 'voluminous ... requests for data' in the plain meaning of the words — the volume is inherent to the census design (every session since 2018-08-01), not an artifact of pacing; the plan's own COMPATIBLE branch concedes this by permitting only 'low volume per session' retrieval, which cannot deliver the F5 full-window census. PLAIN-READING CONFLICT with use (i).

clause_by_clause_analysis.text_verbatim: use any portion of the FINRA Website in the development of any software program or in conjunction with any machine learning, neural network, deep learning, predictive analytics or other artificial intelligence computer or software program, including, without limitation, by using any portion of the FINRA Website in conjunction with a model, algorithm, or process that is designed to predict trades for or within an individual portfolio, fund, or other investment vehicle;
clause_by_clause_analysis.reasoning: This clause prohibits using any portion of the FINRA Website in the development of any software program, and expressly any use 'in conjunction with a model, algorithm, or process that is designed to predict trades for or within an individual portfolio, fund, or other investment vehicle'. Use (ii) — this cycle's stated scientific purpose — is building models of later returns that feed scored, cost-charged trading books with entry/exit rules, gross and symbol caps (plan §7): precisely a process designed to predict outcomes for portfolio trading decisions. The clause's 'development of any software program' limb independently reaches building the census/parser/model pipeline itself. PLAIN-READING CONFLICT with use (ii). This clause alone is decisive for use (ii) and cannot be engineered around by pacing or scoping.

interpretive_question_recorded.question: Does 'the FINRA Website' reach the cdn.finra.org daily-file bytes, or only finra.org HTML pages?
interpretive_question_recorded.plain_reading: The ToU defines the FINRA Website as 'the FINRA.ORG site, including all of its content'. The daily files are FINRA-published content served on FINRA-controlled domains and presented through the FINRA Website's own data catalog, whose only terms link is the site-wide ToU. The plain reading reaches the files.
interpretive_question_recorded.contrary_reading_and_why_it_does_not_res: A strained reading could confine 'FINRA Website' to HTML pages. But then NO operative terms would govern the data at all — no data-specific terms page exists (404), none is linked, and the only 'non-commercial use' sentence on finra.org is scoped to saved-views/Bond-Watchlist login features. A use governed by no locatable terms cannot be COMPATIBLE under this cycle's evidence-first doctrine; it would be AMBIGUOUS, which is equally terminal. So both readings close the cycle identically.
interpretive_question_recorded.conclusion: The interpretive question does not change the outcome: plain reading => INCOMPATIBLE; contrary reading => AMBIGUOUS (fail-closed). Either way the cycle does not proceed to F2.

conflict_statement: The operative Restrictions conflict on their plain reading with both preregistered uses: (d), (e) and (g) prohibit the census-scale programmatic retrieval and census database construction of use (i); (m) prohibits building predictive models of later returns from this source (use (ii)). No permissive data-specific terms exist to invoke the exception embedded in (d). The Permitted Uses grant ('ONLY for your own non-commercial personal or professional use') is expressly 'Subject to Restrictions' and therefore cannot rescue a use a Restriction forbids.
consequence_from_plan: INCOMPATIBLE => terminal close STOCKS_NG4_BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_SCHEMA, budget 0/6; no bulk retrieval ever runs in-cycle. F2-F8 do not dispatch. No adapter repair occurs in-cycle (research/data_fusion/ untouched). Reopening requires a frozen, explicit OWNER decision or a FINRA data license — both owner-only actions outside cycle scope. A correct early close is success of governance, not failure of engineering.
